Use case: Retains licenses and source locations for the bounded allocation runtime.
What it does: Attributes the unmodified OR-Tools wheel and its native/Python dependencies.

OR-Tools 9.15.6755; Google source 551ad10d94835c99e5e1e684500d3db398c0e345.
https://github.com/google/or-tools/tree/551ad10d94835c99e5e1e684500d3db398c0e345
Verified cp312 Linux x86_64 wheel SHA256: 033836c0eb33bc72697a299e0caedbb25fc9d1cee0b13832d69cb30405f57b3e.

Syntelio invokes only CP-SAT. The unmodified wheel also distributes other solver libraries.
Those components retain their own licenses. No third-party solver source was modified by Syntelio.
Upstream OR-Tools build patches and exact dependency declarations remain available at:
https://github.com/google/or-tools/tree/551ad10d94835c99e5e1e684500d3db398c0e345/patches
https://github.com/google/or-tools/blob/551ad10d94835c99e5e1e684500d3db398c0e345/cmake/dependencies/CMakeLists.txt

COIN-OR components are under the Eclipse Public License 2.0. Corresponding source is available
from the linked exact source tags and upstream OR-Tools patches. These notices do not restrict
recipients' rights under those licenses. Eigen source uses MPL2-only build configuration.
GLPK is disabled by the upstream default and no GLPK shared library occurs in the verified wheel.

Upstream OR-Tools declares bzip2 master, not an immutable source pin; exact bzip2 source commit
cannot be inferred from that declaration. The unmodified wheel hash above fixes binary bytes.

All copied license texts retain their original wording. These files and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
are included in the API image and under the web /third-party/ path.
